title: Sr. Staff Product Manager, AI-Native IT Service Management
description:
About the team
Service Operations is where enterprises find out whether their technology actually works. An outage starts, someone gets paged, a bridge call spins up, and the first twenty minutes go to working out what broke rather than fixing it.
Our team owns the products that close that gap: incident and major incident, problem and root cause, change, on-call, and Notify. The people using them go well beyond the service desk, from application, platform, infrastructure, and network teams to DevOps and SRE groups who get alerted around the clock and the major incident commanders pulling everyone onto one call. Thousands of the largest IT organizations run their operations on these products. We are rebuilding them AI-native, not AI-assisted, with agents that triage, correlate, and resolve, and with people moving from doing the work to directing it. Our goal is Zero Service Outage.
About the role
You will own a piece of that portfolio outright: what good looks like for it, who it is for, and whether we are honestly there yet. Zero Service Outage is the goal, and the work is making it true for the customers who run their operations on these products every day.
The interesting part of this job is not the model. It is the environment it runs in. Service operations data is the messiest data in the enterprise: half-populated CMDBs, incident descriptions written in a hurry at 2am, alert noise from a dozen monitoring tools, and naming conventions that differ by region. An agent that triages perfectly against a clean eval set can behave very differently against a real customer’s incident stream, for reasons that have nothing to do with reasoning ability. Understanding why, and designing for it, is the job.
We also carry an installed base. Customers run today’s experience in production, and moving them onto an AI-native one is not a UI refresh. It is a change to how their IT team works, who approves what, and what an operator trusts an agent to do unsupervised. You will be making calls about what we carry forward, what we leave behind, and what we have to earn the right to automate.
How we work is changing as fast as what we build. Prototype instead of describing the idea. Put a working demo in front of people instead of a slide about a demo. Draft the spec, stand up a rough eval harness, pull your own data. ServiceNow invests in state-of-the-art tooling and expects you to use it. Product managers are better positioned than anyone to lead that shift, and part of this role is pulling the team around you into it.
What you get to do in this role

• Own an AI-native ITSM product end to end, from the customer problem through launch criteria to how it performs in production.

• Set product strategy for the Service Operations portfolio that supports ServiceNow ’s growth toward $10B+ in revenue.

• Build, not just specify. Prototype the interaction, stand up the eval harness, and get into the agent execution logs to understand what happened on the runs that failed.

• Define what good means for an autonomous agent in an operational context where the cost of a wrong action is a second outage. Hold the line on it with engineering and have the honest conversation about what we can defensibly promise.

• Work with design partners across the teams that run on this: service desk, application and infrastructure support, DevOps and SRE, and major incident command. Build in their environment against their real incidents, changes, and RCAs, then turn what you learn into something that generalizes to the next thousand customers.

• Own your outcome metrics, such as time to resolve, change failure rate, and repeat incidents, in partnership with Customer Success, and make sure the instrumentation exists to show whether what you shipped moved them.

• Align with peer product managers so the team is working on the right things at the right time and guide multiple teams through ambiguous product development without losing sight of the unified vision.

• Write

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About Learning Sandbox

We create learning experiences that engage, empower and inspire. Learning Sandbox is a global learning consultancy bringing together learning, creativity and technology to help organisations solve meaningful learning challenges.
Our work spans digital learning, education, science, technology and everything in between. We work with ambitious organisations and multidisciplinary teams to turn complex ideas into experiences that are clear, engaging and impactful.
We’re a curious, collaborative team that cares about putting people first, growing together and doing exceptional work that enriches the world.
About our client: LabXchange
LabXchange is a nonprofit education project based at Harvard University. Too many students, whether because of economic or geographic limitations, lack access to high-quality science education and the chance to engage meaningfully in the scientific process. Globally, this has led to significant gaps in diversity across scientific fields and in scientific literacy overall. LabXchange believes students everywhere should have an equal opportunity to prepare for and succeed in science.
To make that real, LabXchange offers the best of digital science education to teachers and students around the world, for free, through an advanced, flexible and interactive learning platform. It goes well beyond text, video and multiple-choice questions, with virtual lab simulations, interactive animations, experimental design simulations and a knowledge graph that can be remixed into customised learning pathways. Social features like private classes, discussion forums and mentorship connect learners with educators.
About the role
We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own growth for the LabXchange platform: more learners and educators finding it, and more of them coming back. You'll set the growth strategy, turn data into a clear roadmap, and work with engineering, design, content and marketing to ship experiments that move acquisition, activation and engagement. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in a dashboard as in a roadmap review.
What you’ll be doing

• Own the growth strategy for LabXchange across acquisition, activation, engagement and retention, and turn it into a prioritised roadmap. This will include the USA and a global strategy.

• Grow the user base by finding and scaling the channels that bring in students, educators and institutions, including organic search, marketing, partnerships and referral loops.

• Increase engagement by improving onboarding, discovery and the paths that bring learners and educators back week after week.

• Lead with data. Define the growth metrics, build and maintain dashboards, run funnel and cohort analysis, and use the findings to decide what to build next.

• Run a steady experimentation programme: form hypotheses, design A/B tests, size impact and share what you learn.

• Drive SEO and content discoverability with content and engineering teams, so our simulations, lessons and pathways reach people searching for them.

• Manage the core library experience: how learners and educators find, browse and reach the right content, and how the library is organised so that it happens quickly. Manage the development and redesign of the LabXchange platform.

• Work across teams with engineering, design, content, marketing and partners, and keep stakeholders and funders informed on progress and results.

• Manage stakeholders and projects across multiple capabilities (engineering, design, content, marketing and partners), keeping priorities, timelines, dependencies and expectations aligned from kickoff through delivery.

• Keep stakeholders in the loop. Announce releases in various Slack channels and facilitate catchups with various stakeholders.

• Bring in the user's voice through interviews, surveys and usability testing with students and educators around the world.

• Manage a multi-timezone team to achieve LabXchange’s growth goa

Own quality from the wrist to the cloud. Join a lean health-technology team building a wearable platform that turns continuous biometric signals into data researchers, health systems, and enterprise partners can trust.

Take ownership across the entire product, shape the quality function, and make a visible difference to a platform people rely on every night. This player-coach role keeps you close to the code, the devices, and the decisions.

title: Sr. Robotic Software Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Aurelius is the autonomous directed energy company.

We are a group of engineers, operators, and company patriots building American-made, laser-based counter-UAS systems that neutralize aerial threats.

Archimedes, our autonomous laser turret, combines a high-power laser with radar and machine vision to find, track, and defeat small drones. We design in San Francisco, manufacture in Detroit, and test onsite, on our own cUAS range.

THE ROLE

You'll write production C++ across the Archimedes robotics stack: tracking, control, and autonomy.

You'll own features end to end, make them fast, and make sure they hold up in the field. Quality, tests, and CI are part of the job. You'll tighten performance and timing on the paths you own and build the test and CI discipline the team ships with. You'll work daily with controls, embedded, electrical, and the principal engineer who owns stack architecture.

MUST-HAVES

- Strong production C++ on shipped, hardware-facing systems. C++ is the core stack and Python is for tooling.

- Real-time and performance experience, including concurrency, profiling, latency, and timing analysis

- Built or operated CI/CD or hardware-in-the-loop testing for robotics or other hardware-facing systems

- Ownership of quality. You've seen what bad test discipline costs in the field, and you fix it without being asked.

- U.S. citizenship, required for export control

FIRST 6 MONTHS

- Ship end-to-end features in production C++, from sensor data through tracking, control, or autonomy, used on the range

- Analyze threading, process structure, and timing on the hot paths you own, with measured latency improvements

- Build test coverage and automated checks into how the team ships, so failures are caught before a range day

- Set up CI/CD and deployment practices for robotics and hardware-in-the-loop so fielded builds are reproducible

- Raise the quality bar across the robotics software team through code review

NICE TO HAVES

- ROS2, and the judgment to know when not to use it

- Motion planning, trajectory optimization, state estimation, or sensor fusion

- Built test automation frameworks for robotics or hardware-in-the-loop

- An active security clearance, or the ability to get one

NOT A FIT IF

- Your background is web, backend, or full stack, or you're a researcher who hasn't shipped to hardware

- You're a QA specialist who doesn't write production code, or you think test discipline is someone else's job

- You need remote or hybrid work

HOW WE WORK

At Aurelius we work what we call, 5+X. Our core operating hours are 5 days a week, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Pacific Time.

The X is the honest acknowledgment that hard work sometimes takes more. That can be late nights and weekends during sprints and ramp-up periods or conferences, deployments, and events when the mission calls for it.

This role is onsite 5 days a week in San Francisco.

BENEFITS

At Aurelius Systems, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package is available at little to no cost to employees and supports health, recovery, and whatever comes next. Explore Our Benefits https://www.aureliussystems.com/careers#:~:text=Explore%20Our%20Benefits.

EXPORT CONTROL NOTICE

This role requires access to export-controlled information or items and requires U.S. citizenship.

NOT A PERFECT FIT?

Email our Head of Talent, alfredo@aureliussystems.us with the most extraordinary thing you've built or done.

• 2-4 years of program or project management experience (or equivalent), ideally touching infrastructure, platform, or cloud environments.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is building a new AI business, and you’ll be one of its first technical sellers. Your job is to turn technically complex AI products into closed revenue.

You’ll sell a growing portfolio spanning AI-powered applications and agents for finance teams, as well as infrastructure that helps companies deploy and manage AI with greater control, security, and cost efficiency. This is a product-focused, quota-carrying technical sales role. You’ll help customers evaluate and purchase Ramp’s AI products, translating complex capabilities into clear business value and guiding opportunities from discovery through close.

You’ll own the full customer lifecycle from discovery and evaluation through close, implementation, and adoption, helping customers translate their purchase into a successful deployment. This role combines Ramp’s resources and customer reach with the ownership, speed, and ambiguity of an early-stage team.

Overview
The Lifeway Internship Program is a unique opportunity designed to provide college students and recent graduates with a valuable learning experience that fosters growth both professionally, personally, and spiritually. Our internships go far beyond "busy work"-you’ll engage in meaningful projects, gain hands-on experience, and be empowered to make an impact. Interns at Lifeway receive professional development, have opportunities for exposure to senior leaders, and benefit from mentoring relationships with experts in their chosen field.
Job Overview
This intern will help the Organizational Development team put AI to work in everyday OD and HR processes. Based on the OD & Talent Experience team and partnering closely with IT Operations, you will find HR processes that AI can improve, build a suite of HR applications in Claude, and contribute to the adoption and change management work that gets them implemented. title: Bioinformatics Scientist (Oncology Product Development)
description:
Natera is currently seeking a Bioinformatics Scientist to join the Bioinformatics team focused on Oncology Product Development. The individual will participate in the design and prototyping of cutting-edge algorithms for analysis of genetic data and the development and validation of ctDNA-based diagnostic tests. The ideal candidate will be an enthusiastic, flexible team member with a strong background in bioinformatics and data science, optimally with experience in the analysis or modeling of DNA methylation data.
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Analyze next-generation sequencing data ranging from single research experiments to commercial datasets containing hundreds of thousands of samples.

• Develop Python software infrastructure to support algorithm testing and simulation studies.

• Produce correct conclusions based on rigorous mathematical analysis and principles of statistics and probability.

• Contribute to product development and validation efforts in the Bioinformatics group.

• Drive rigorous data analysis efforts and support group efforts in the production of high-quality documentation.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Requirements:

• Master’s degree or PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, engineering, statistics, or a related field; Bachelor’s degree with 2+ years of relevant experience will be considered.

• At least 2 years of hands-on experience in statistical analysis of biological data using Python or R; analysis of high-throughput genomic sequencing data is preferred.

Desirable, but not required:

• Prior experience analyzing or modeling DNA methylation data.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Experience using Python or R for scientific data analysis and visualization.

• Strong foundation in statistical modeling/machine learning, including probability theory and estimation/classification methods.

• Experience with analysis of next-generation sequencing data, preferably including algorithm performance evaluation.

• Experience with analysis and visualization of complex datasets.

• Proven ability to apply mathematical principles to solve real estimation problems and implement practical solutions.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the desire to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$101,800-$127,300 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera ™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera , you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit .

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

- You’ll have expertise building and deploying production level data processing batch systems maintained by application support teams. - Experience with a variety of modern development tooling (e.g. Git, Gradle, Nexus) and tech

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
At Vyn, we're reimagining how work gets done in the deskless world.

Our platform enriches expertly-curated short videos captured before, during, and after work with AI-powered automated workflows. We own the world's largest dataset of this kind, enabling field users and customers to make smarter, more efficient decisions about their assets and operations.

Our purpose is to deliver transformative commercial and environmental outcomes, helping global clients across utilities, telecoms, retail and energy improve pricing accuracy, speed up delivery, ensure safety, and maintain compliance.

Vyntelligence is a fast-growing SaaS company using Agentic Video Intelligence to transform field, asset and customer operations. Our customers are utilities, telecoms, energy and infrastructure organisations across the UK and Europe.

You'll own delivery for our UK and European customers, from signed SOW to go-live. You're the customer's engagement manager, and technical enough to keep scope, risk and quality on track. You'll lead our India-based engineering and solutions teams across time zones.

- Run kick-offs, status meetings and steering committees with customer stakeholders, up to executive level.

- Turn each SOW into a delivery plan and run several deliveries in parallel, with formal change control.

- Work with our engineers and customer IT on integrations, security and data.

- Lead UAT, go-live and cutover, then hand over to Customer Success.

- Build our delivery playbooks and share what you learn with Product and Pre-Sales.

- Minimum 5 years in technical delivery or IT project management, with at least 3 on customer-facing SaaS or enterprise software.

- Direct experience with UK or European enterprise customers.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or similar.

Nice to have: MBA degree, PMP or PRINCE2, experience in utilities, telecoms or field service, and AWS or Jira.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Anthropic (m/f/d)
locationText: Berlin, Berlin; Hamburg, Hamburg; München, Bavaria
description:
About us

Artefact is a data and AI services company with around 2,500 people across 36 offices. We are part of Anthropic's Claude Partner Network and have rolled out Claude across our own organization, so our advice to clients comes from running it ourselves first.

DeployCo is Artefact's team dedicated to deploying Claude at scale inside enterprises. It works through three levers. Deployment and adoption gets organizations from a few early adopters to company-wide use. Process reimagination redesigns core workflows around agentic AI. Agent production ships working agents into client systems. Forward Deployed Engineers are the builders behind the third lever and the technical backbone of the other two.

The role

As an FDE you join a client's own AI or engineering team as a builder, not an advisor. You design, code, and ship production-grade Claude solutions directly inside their stack, following their conventions, repositories, and CI. You also leave the capability behind, so that when the engagement ends the client's engineers can extend and maintain what was built without us.
The work ranges from short, intense engagements, like standing up a governed Claude Code deployment in a few weeks, to longer embeds where you become the technical anchor of a multi-agent portfolio and a larger Artefact pod grows around you. This is a senior role, and we expect you to own technical direction on an engagement from the first week.

What you'll do

• Build production agents. Design and deploy Claude-based agents and workflows that run in production, with the engineering standards that implies. That means tests, error handling, monitoring, and cost control.

• Connect Claude to enterprise systems. Build custom MCP servers

title: MaKo Specialist Forderungsmanagement (d/w/m)
description:
Deine Mission
Als MaKo Specialist Forderungsmanagement bei SpotmyEnergy sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Forderungen gegenüber Netzbetreibern vollständig, korrekt und fristgerecht abgerechnet und realisiert werden. Im Fokus stehen die Abrechnung der Preisobergrenze (POG) im Messstellenbetrieb sowie Modul 1 und Modul 3 nach § 14a EnWG. Du baust diesen Bereich bei uns maßgeblich mit auf und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass unser Geschäftsmodell als Lieferant und wettbewerblicher Messstellenbetreiber wirtschaftlich stabil läuft.
Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung des Forderungsmanagements gegenüber Verteilnetzbetreibern für POG-, Modul-1- und Modul-3-Forderungen
Abrechnung des Zählerrückversands gegenüber den Netzbetreibern
Erstellung, Prüfung und Versand von Abrechnungen sowie Abgleich der Zahlungseingänge und Zahlungsavise (INVOIC/REMADV)
Klärung von Abweichungen, Rechnungsablehnungen und Kürzungen in Abstimmung mit den Netzbetreibern
Mahnwesen und Eskalation offener Posten
Prüfung der abrechnungsrelevanten Stammdaten (MaLo/MeLo, Zeitscheiben, Konfigurationen) als Grundlage für korrekte Rechnungen
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Billing, Finance, MaKo-Kolleg:innen sowie externen Dienstleistern
Reporting zu offenen Forderungen und Klärfällen
Mitarbeit an der Automatisierung und Optimierung der Abrechnungs- und Forderungsprozesse

Dein Profil

Kaufmännische oder energiewirtschaftliche Ausbildung bzw. ein entsprechendes Studium
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Forderungsmanagement oder in der Abrechnung in der Energiewirtschaft, idealerweise in der Netznutzungs- oder MSB-Abrechnung
Kenntnisse der Marktkommunikation (INVOIC, REMADV, UTILMD, MSCONS) sowie der regulatorischen Grundlagen (MsbG, § 14a EnWG)
Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und großen Datenmengen
Strukturierte, hartnäckige Arbeitsweise und Freude daran,

description:
About Megaport
We’re not your typical tech company - and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here - collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. Working within the DIOPS team and reporting to the DIOPS Regional Manager, the role executes the full delivery workflow, from order intake to customer handoff, ensuring each server is configured correctly, tested, and delivered within the timeframe agreed at the point of sale.
This is an execution-focused technical role.
